fusions.name: Winding Fetter
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 14 damage, leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Flail Circuit
fusions.desc: Whirls the chain in a full circle that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 4 seconds. [Slowed] passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Harbour Boom
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier of links 6 tiles long for 8 seconds that nothing can cross. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Drive Train
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
